items.title: MAGMA: A Multi-Graph based Agentic Memory Architecture for AI Agents
items.title_zh: MAGMA：面向 AI 智能体的多图智能体记忆架构
items.summary: MAGMA represents each memory item across orthogonal semantic, temporal, causal and entity graphs, then formulates retrieval as policy-guided traversal over those relational views for query-adaptive context construction. It reports consistent gains over state-of-the-art agentic memory systems on LoCoMo and LongMemEval long-horizon reasoning tasks.

items.title: Inside Out: Evolving User-Centric Core Memory Trees for Long-Term Personalized Dialogue Systems
items.title_zh: 由内而外：为长期个性化对话系统演化以用户为中心的核心记忆树
items.summary: Inside Out maintains a PersonaTree as a long-term user profile, constraining the trunk with an initial schema and updating branches and leaves to compress memory while preserving persona consistency. A lightweight MemListener trained with reinforcement learning and process-based rewards produces ADD, UPDATE, DELETE and NO_OP operations, with the small model matching or surpassing much larger reasoning models on memory-operation decisions.

items.title: Overcoming the Retrieval Barrier: Indirect Prompt Injection in the Wild for LLM Systems
items.title_zh: 跨越检索门槛：LLM 系统中真实场景的间接提示注入
items.summary: The authors show that malicious content can be divided into a trigger piece engineered to be retrieved and a separate payload, achieving near-perfect retrieval on 11 benchmarks and eight embedding models for as little as $0.21 per targeted query. In a demonstration, one poisoned email caused GPT-4o to leak SSH keys in more than 80% of attempts within a multi-agent workflow.

items.title: Don't Break the Cache: An Evaluation of Prompt Caching for Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
items.title_zh: 别破坏缓存：长时程智能体任务中提示缓存的评估
items.summary: The paper evaluates prompt caching across OpenAI, Anthropic and Google on DeepResearch Bench, covering over 500 agent sessions with 10,000-token system prompts. It finds API cost reductions of 41–80% and time-to-first-token improvements of 13–31%, and reports that strategic cache-block control beats naive full-context caching, which can increase latency.

items.title: Domain Specific Specialization in Low-Resource Settings: The Efficacy of Offline Response-Based Knowledge Distillation in Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 低资源场景下的领域特化：离线响应式知识蒸馏在大模型中的有效性
items.summary: The authors compare three data strategies for offline response-based distillation into Qwen2.5-7B, using Unsloth to cut A100 memory from 40 GB to 16 GB. They find larger unstructured knowledge-injection datasets still hallucinate, while a 500-line context-aware synthetic dataset reaches 96.7% accuracy with robust rejection, supporting the view that data quality and structure matter more than quantity.

items.title: ACDZero: MCTS Agent for Mastering Automated Cyber Defense
items.title_zh: ACDZero：用于自动化网络防御的 MCTS 智能体
items.summary: ACDZero frames automated cyber defense in the CAGE Challenge 4 as a partially observable Markov decision problem and uses Monte Carlo tree search guided by graph-neural-network embeddings of network observations and learned priors over graph-edit actions. In CC4 scenarios with varied network structures and adversary behavior, it improves defense reward and robustness over state-of-the-art reinforcement-learning baselines.

items.title: From XAI to Stories: A Factorial Study of LLM-Generated Explanation Quality
items.title_zh: 从 XAI 到叙事：大模型生成解释质量的因子研究
items.summary: This factorial study examines how forecasting model choice, XAI method, LLM selection and prompting strategy affect natural-language explanations of model behavior, evaluating 660 explanations with G-Eval and dual judges. It finds that LLM choice dominates, XAI adds only small gains mainly for experts, zero-shot prompting is competitive with self-consistency at seven times lower cost, and chain-of-thought hurts in this setting.

items.title: Enhancing Model Context Protocol (MCP) with Context-Aware Server Collaboration
items.title_zh: 通过上下文感知的服务器协作增强模型上下文协议（MCP）
items.summary: The paper designs CA-MCP, which offloads execution logic to specialized MCP servers that read from and write to a shared context store so agents can coordinate without repeated prompting. On TravelPlanner and REALM-Bench it reports fewer LLM calls and fewer response failures than traditional MCP.

items.title: Scaling Trends for Multi-Hop Contextual Reasoning in Mid-Scale Language Models
items.title_zh: 中等规模语言模型多跳上下文推理的扩展趋势
items.summary: A controlled study with 120 trials across four mid-scale models finds a task-method dissociation: rule-based matching reaches 100% on structured retrieval but 6.7% on cross-document reasoning, while LLM multi-agent systems reach up to 80% on the latter. Multi-agent gains appear only for models with sufficient base reasoning ability, with improvements up to 46.7 percentage points.

items.title: KDCM: Reducing Hallucination in LLMs through Explicit Reasoning Structures
items.title_zh: KDCM：通过显式推理结构减少大语言模型幻觉
items.summary: KDCM extends chain-style knowledge distillation with a programmable module that guides knowledge graph exploration as executable code inside the reasoning prompt. On public benchmarks with GPT-4 and LLaMA-3.3 it reports HIT@1, HIT@3 and HIT@5 gains of 15.64%, 13.38% and 13.28% and reduced prompt-induced hallucination.

items.title: Improving Enzyme Prediction with Chemical Reaction Equations by Hypergraph-Enhanced Knowledge Graph Embeddings
items.title_zh: 利用化学反应方程式与超图增强知识图谱嵌入改进酶预测
items.summary: The paper represents chemical reaction equations as (educt, enzyme, product) triples in a knowledge graph and combines a hypergraph transformer with knowledge graph embedding to infer missing enzyme–substrate pairs. It reports up to 88% relative improvement in average enzyme retrieval accuracy and 30% in pair-level prediction over traditional models.

items.title: Same Claim, Different Judgment: Benchmarking Scenario-Induced Bias in Multilingual Financial Misinformation Detection
items.title_zh: 同一说法，不同判断：多语言金融虚假信息检测中的情境诱导偏差基准
items.summary: MFMDScen pairs complex financial scenarios—varying role and personality, role and region, and role with ethnicity and religious beliefs—with multilingual misinformation claims in English, Chinese, Greek and Bengali. Evaluating 22 mainstream LLMs, it finds pronounced behavioral biases in both commercial and open-source models.

items.title: Can We Predict Before Executing Machine Learning Agents?
items.title_zh: 我们能在执行前预测机器学习智能体的结果吗？
items.summary: The paper formalizes data-centric solution preference with a corpus of 18,438 pairwise comparisons and shows LLMs can predict outcomes at 61.5% accuracy when primed with a verified data analysis report. It instantiates FOREAGENT with a predict-then-verify loop that reports 6x faster convergence and +6% over execution-based baselines.

items.title: Are LLMs Vulnerable to Preference-Undermining Attacks (PUA)? A Factorial Analysis Methodology for Diagnosing the Trade-off between Preference Alignment and Real-World Validity
items.title_zh: 大语言模型易受偏好削弱攻击吗？诊断偏好对齐与现实有效性权衡的因子分析方法
items.summary: The paper introduces Preference-Undermining Attacks, manipulative prompts that exploit an aligned model's desire to please users at the expense of truthfulness, and proposes a factorial 2×2⁴ diagnostic framework. It finds that more advanced models are sometimes more susceptible, with reality denial the dominant factor and model-specific interactions suggesting tailored defenses.

items.title: Evaluating Accounting Reasoning Capabilities of Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 评估大语言模型的会计推理能力
items.summary: The authors define vertical-domain accounting reasoning, derive evaluation criteria from GLM training-data characteristics, and test GLM-6B, GLM-130B, GLM-4 and GPT-4 on accounting tasks. Prompt design significantly affected performance, GPT-4 was strongest, and the models remained insufficient for real-world enterprise accounting.

items.title: Dr. Zero: Self-Evolving Search Agents without Training Data
items.title_zh: Dr. Zero：无需训练数据的自进化搜索智能体
items.summary: Dr. Zero is a framework that lets multi-turn search agents self-evolve without human-annotated training data, relying only on an external search engine as their knowledge environment. A proposer generates structurally diverse questions to train a solver, and hop-grouped relative policy optimization (HRPO) reduces the compute needed for proposer training; the authors report it matches or surpasses fully supervised search agents on several question answering benchmarks.

items.title: SDUs DAISY: A Benchmark for Danish Culture
items.title_zh: SDU 的 DAISY：丹麦文化基准测试
items.summary: DAISY is a factual-knowledge test derived from the 2006 Danish Culture Canon, containing 741 closed-ended question-answer pairs that were checked by hand. Current models did badly: Llama-3.3-70B was the strongest but scored just 0.17 BLEU and 0.27 F1.

items.title: ELLA: Efficient Lifelong Learning for Adapters in Large Language Models
items.title_zh: ELLA：面向大模型适配器的高效终身学习
items.summary: ELLA replaces strict orthogonality in continual learning with selective subspace decorrelation, penalizing alignment along high-energy task-specific directions while leaving low-energy residual subspaces free for transfer. It requires no replay or architectural expansion, reports state-of-the-art continual-learning results with up to 9.6% relative accuracy gains and a 35x smaller memory footprint, and improves zero-shot generalization to unseen tasks.

items.title: Scalable Construction of a Lung Cancer Knowledge Base: Profiling Semantic Reasoning in LLMs
items.title_zh: 可扩展肺癌知识库构建：刻画大模型的语义推理能力
items.summary: The study builds a lung cancer knowledge base with open information extraction, combining MeSH concepts, CC0-licensed PubMed literature, subject-relation-object triplets and NER enrichment, then fine-tunes T5 models. It reports improved ROUGE and BERTScore results.

items.title: InfiAgent: An Infinite-Horizon Framework for General-Purpose Autonomous Agents
items.title_zh: InfiAgent：面向通用自主智能体的无限时程框架
items.summary: InfiAgent keeps an agent's reasoning context bounded by externalizing persistent state into a file-centric abstraction and rebuilding context at each step from a workspace snapshot plus a fixed window of recent actions. With a 20B open-source model it is competitive with larger proprietary systems on DeepResearch and an 80-paper literature review task, with higher long-horizon coverage than context-centric baselines.

items.title: Multi-RADS Synthetic Radiology Report Dataset and Head-to-Head Benchmarking of 41 Open-Weight and Proprietary Language Models
items.title_zh: 多 RADS 合成放射学报告数据集及 41 个开放权重与专有语言模型的头对头基准测试
items.summary: The study releases RXL-RADSet, 1,600 radiologist-verified synthetic reports across 10 RADS frameworks, and benchmarks 41 quantized small language models against GPT-5.2 under guided prompting. GPT-5.2 reached 99.8% validity and 81.1% accuracy, while pooled small models reached 96.8% validity and 61.1% accuracy, with top 20–32B models approaching proprietary performance.

items.title: ContextFocus: Activation Steering for Contextual Faithfulness in Large Language Models
items.title_zh: ContextFocus：面向大语言模型上下文忠实度的激活引导
items.summary: ContextFocus is a lightweight activation-steering method that improves faithfulness to retrieved context when it conflicts with parametric knowledge, without fine-tuning and with minimal inference overhead. On ConFiQA it reports significant gains over baselines including ContextDPO and COIECD, and the authors say it is complementary to prompting strategies and remains effective on larger models.

items.title: Chain-of-Sanitized-Thoughts: Plugging PII Leakage in CoT of Large Reasoning Models
items.title_zh: 净化思维链：堵住大型推理模型 CoT 中的 PII 泄露
items.summary: The paper introduces PII-CoT-Bench and studies privacy-first reasoning so models do not expose personally identifiable information in intermediate chain-of-thought. It finds state-of-the-art models benefit most from prompt-based controls while weaker models need fine-tuning, with both approaches substantially reducing leakage at minimal utility cost.

items.title: PRISM: Protocol Refinement through Intelligent Simulation Modeling
items.title_zh: PRISM：通过智能仿真建模进行实验协议优化
items.summary: PRISM uses language-model agents to gather procedures, convert them into structured experimental steps through planning, critique and validation loops, and translate them into a robotic-lab protocol format. Protocols are checked in an NVIDIA Omniverse digital twin before execution, with Luna qPCR amplification and Cell Painting as case studies.

items.title: C-World: A Computer Use Agent Environment Creator
items.title_zh: C-World：计算机使用智能体环境创建器
items.summary: C-World lets users build agent environments from an action space of 5,571 format-unified tools across 204 applications, a task distribution engine, a state controller that injects failures and a combined verifiable/LLM reward. Evaluating nine LLMs, it finds execution rather than planning is the bottleneck and constraint following is the dominant failure mode; fine-tuning on 1,170 trajectories outperforms baselines trained on 119k samples.

items.title: ArenaRL: Scaling RL for Open-Ended Agents via Tournament-based Relative Ranking
items.title_zh: ArenaRL：通过锦标赛式相对排序为开放式智能体扩展强化学习
items.summary: ArenaRL replaces pointwise scalar rewards with intra-group relative ranking, using process-aware pairwise evaluation with multi-level rubrics and a tournament scheme to obtain stable advantage signals. It reports near-equivalent advantage accuracy to full pairwise comparison at O(N) instead of O(N²) complexity, introduces the Open-Travel and Open-DeepResearch benchmarks, and substantially outperforms standard RL baselines.

items.title: CloneMem: Benchmarking Long-Term Memory for AI Clones
items.title_zh: CloneMem：面向 AI 克隆的长期记忆基准
items.summary: CloneMem is a benchmark for long-term memory in AI clone scenarios, built from non-conversational digital traces such as diaries, social media posts and emails spanning one to three years rather than temporally fragmented chat histories. It defines tasks that assess an agent's ability to track evolving personal states and reports that current memory mechanisms struggle in this setting.

items.title: Explore with Long-term Memory: A Benchmark and Multimodal LLM-based Reinforcement Learning Framework for Embodied Exploration
items.title_zh: 带着长期记忆探索：具身探索的基准与多模态 LLM 强化学习框架
items.summary: The authors introduce Long-term Memory Embodied Exploration (LMEE) and the LMEE-Bench dataset, which combines multi-goal navigation with memory-based question answering to evaluate both the process and outcome of embodied exploration. Their MemoryExplorer method fine-tunes a multimodal LLM with reinforcement learning and a multi-task reward over action prediction, frontier selection and question answering, reporting advantages on long-horizon embodied tasks.

items.title: Orchestral AI: A Framework for Agent Orchestration
items.title_zh: Orchestral AI：智能体编排框架
items.summary: Orchestral is a lightweight Python framework that gives developers a single type-safe interface for LLM agents across major providers, deriving tool schemas from Python type hints and using a synchronous streaming execution model. It supports sandboxing, sub-agents, memory and MCP.

items.title: volcengine/OpenViking
items.title_zh: volcengine/OpenViking：面向 AI 智能体的自演化上下文数据库
items.summary: OpenViking is a Python self-evolving context database for AI agents that unifies agent memory, knowledge RAG and skills.

items.title: headroomlabs-ai/headroom
items.title_zh: headroomlabs-ai/headroom：为 LLM 压缩工具输出、日志与 RAG 片段
items.summary: headroom compresses tool outputs, logs, files and RAG chunks before they reach an LLM, claiming 20% fewer tokens for coding agents and 60–95% fewer for JSON with the same answers. It ships as a library, proxy and MCP server.

items.title: FlorianBruniaux/claude-code-ultimate-guide
items.title_zh: FlorianBruniaux/claude-code-ultimate-guide：最全面的 Claude Code 指南
items.summary: A Claude Code guide covering agentic workflows, hooks, skills, MCP servers, quizzes and production-ready templates, described as spanning more than 430K lines.

items.title: Yeachan-Heo/oh-my-claudecode
items.title_zh: Yeachan-Heo/oh-my-claudecode：面向团队的 Claude Code 多智能体编排
items.summary: A TypeScript project offering teams-first multi-agent orchestration for Claude Code.

items.title: tickernelz/opencode-mem
items.title_zh: tickernelz/opencode-mem：为 OpenCode 编码智能体提供持久记忆
items.summary: opencode-mem is a TypeScript plugin that gives OpenCode coding agents persistent memory backed by a local vector database.

items.title: vercel-labs/agent-browser
items.title_zh: vercel-labs/agent-browser：面向 AI 智能体的浏览器自动化 CLI
items.summary: vercel-labs/agent-browser is a Rust browser-automation command-line tool for AI agents, published under Vercel Labs.

items.title: Show HN: Similarity = cosine(your_GitHub_stars, Karpathy) Client-side
items.title_zh: Show HN：相似度 = cosine（你的 GitHub 星标，Karpathy），客户端运行
items.summary: A client-side tool builds an embedding from a user's GitHub stars, then compares interests with other users, generates a skill radar and recommends repositories.

items.title: How Tolan builds voice-first AI with GPT-5.1
items.title_zh: Tolan 如何用 GPT-5.1 构建语音优先的 AI
items.summary: OpenAI describes how Tolan built a voice-first AI companion on GPT-5.1, combining low-latency responses, real-time context reconstruction and memory-driven personalities for natural conversation.

items.title: Netomi’s lessons for scaling agentic systems into the enterprise
items.title_zh: Netomi 将智能体系统扩展到企业规模的经验
items.summary: OpenAI describes how Netomi scales enterprise AI agents with GPT-4.1 and GPT-5.2, combining concurrency, governance and multi-step reasoning for reliable production workflows.

items.title: Show HN: I used Claude Code to discover connections between 100 books
items.title_zh: Show HN：我用 Claude Code 发现 100 本书之间的关联
items.summary: The author describes building a system that lets Claude Code browse 100 non-fiction books and surface connections between them, and says giving the agent access to debug CLI tools worked far better than a staged LLM pipeline with little orchestration.

items.title: Agentic AI Empowered Intent-Based Networking for 6G
items.title_zh: 面向 6G 的智能体 AI 赋能意图网络
items.summary: The paper presents a hierarchical multi-agent framework in which LLM agents decompose natural-language intents, consult RAN and core-network specialists and synthesize feasible network-slice configurations through ReAct-style cycles. It reports gains over monolithic agents, rule-based systems and direct prompting, and argues that structured prompts encoding domain thresholds and policies are essential for reliable automation.
